en: A place to catch our breath. Thank you, York.
Ah, and Takane. Make sure to keep Usami safe, alright?
Ah, it's you girls.
All right. Let us see what you have.
Before we head out, [color=red]we need to speak with everyone in Station 45-B[/color].
I'll be on my best behavior. Probably.
I make equipment from what you bring back. Pick a design, and I'll tell you which creatures to hunt.
Looking to trade? Choose what you're offering and what you want. I'll tell you whether we have a deal.
Ready! Let's all stay together.
Miss York! We're going exploring now!
York
Thank you, Miss York! You're always so nice to us!
York
You're such a sweetie, little Usami. Don't forget to come back to take a break often. [color=red]Resting will help you grow stronger[/color].
York
Takane, please make sure to keep Usami safe, alright?
York
Of course. I won't let anything happen to her.
York
... What about me?
York
Ah, it's you girls. Are you all ready for your first expedition?
York
Yes! We've been preparing all month! Mister Cairo has taught us everything about exploring the labyrinth!
York
Cairo is a really nice person, isn't he? By the way... Takane. There's something I wanted to give you.
York
What is it?
York
It's a few field rations. I'm sure Cairo has explained to you how food can become an issue if you stay out on the labyrinth for too long.
York
Eh?! Why Takane?!
York
Because she's Usami's older sister. Also, I don't trust you with food. You would probably eat it all before you even leave Station 45-B.
York
Or sprinkle chilli on them.
York
Or use them as bait to attract mice into the common area.
York
Or trade them for Sydney's prank replicas.
York
Ugh...
Takane received 4 Simple Rations from York.
York
Cairo, we're off to the labyrinth now. Any final advice?
Cairo
Oh, and Takane. Make sure to keep Usami safe, alright?
Cairo
If anybody dares harm her, they'll be met with a swift death.
Cairo
... What about me?
Cairo
Ah, it's you girls. I think you already know everything you need to know to handle the labyrinth outside Station 45-B.
Cairo
Thank you so much for always helping us out, mister Cairo!
Cairo
Don't worry about it. I wouldn't be able to live with myself if I let anything happen to you.
Cairo
I considered trying to stop you... But I've known Kurako long enough to know there's no changing her mind when she gets an idea into her head.
Cairo
I always believed in you, Cairo!
Cairo
You girls will be fine. Just remember the basics. Stay alert, take frequent rests and [color=red]make sure to stay well supplied before entering combat[/color].
Cairo
And if you find anything valuable out there, be sure to bring it back here to [color=red]trade for proper supplies[/color].
Cairo
Understood.
Sydney! We're off to the labyrinth now!
Sydney
Of course. I will not allow anybody to harm her.
Sydney
Et tu, Sydney...?
Sydney
Oh, Kurako! So today's the day, huh?
Sydney
That's right! Kurako-chan, Takane-chan and I are going to be the best explorers in history!
Sydney
Hahahaha! Aim for the stars! I see you're a big dreamer as always.
Sydney
By the way, Kurako. Don't forget your promise, alright? [color=red]Make sure to bring me those monster materials so that I can make you the best gadgets![/color].
Sydney
Of course! I'll bring you the best materials in the labyrinth!
Sydney
Maybe I'll be able to make that invisibility belt after all!
Sydney
... You two are a dangerous combination.
Sydney
Ah, Takane. Make sure to keep Usami safe, alright?
Usami! Are you ready?!
I'm ready, Kurako-chan! This is so exciting!
Just think of all the people waiting to be pranked! This is gonna be so much fun!
This is not a game, Kurako. It is very dangerous out there. Someone could get seriously hurt.
It should go without saying. If something bad happens I'm taking Usami and running back to the Station.
W-What about me?!
Don't worry, Kurako-chan! Takane-chan is a really sweet girl. There's no way she would ever leave you behind! Right, Takane-chan?
S-She's not saying yes...
[color=red]We should let everyone know we're on our way out[/color].
I feel like this station has a very clear favourite...
You, back there. You've been following us since this morning.
Ah! Koumi-chan! Did you come to see us off?
Ugh... Takane-chan...
... It'll be dangerous, are you sure?
I see. I'll try to keep an eye out for you, but Usami is my first priority. Understood?
Hm? Is something wrong, Kurako-chan?
[b][i]*Nods*[/i][/b]
Very well.
... What just happened?
I see... So that's what it is...
Kurako-chan! Please explain it to me!
I am sorry, Usami-chan. But that won't be possible.
Why?!
Because I don't know either!
Don't worry, it's nothing. Let's go explore!
Koumi joined the party.
Yay! The adventure begins now!
What's wrong, Takane-chan?
Hey you. How long are you planning to follow us?
That's so mean! Adventuring was my idea!
I'm not talking to you, Kurako.
Take these rations with you. You may need them out there.
The team received 4 Simple Rations from York.
Uh... Takane-chan...
We've spoken with everyone. Are you ready, Usami?
We will keep an eye out. What are you working on?
Welcome to the barracks. You can rest here and arrange your party before heading out.
... Who's gonna protect me?
Yes! We've been preparing all month! Mister Cairo has taught a lot about exploring!
York! We're going exploring now!
